subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should idle/max-age prune workspace cleanup be folded into the managed sandbox lifecycle work, or should maintainers land a separate narrow prune fix first?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but deleting workspace state is destructive and overlaps with a broader draft lifecycle design plus a conflicting fork PR.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Work
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 explicitly cover idle/max-age workspace cleanup, refresh exact-head proof, and close this issue after that path merges.

options.title: Land A Narrow Prune Fix
options.body: Adopt a focused fix that removes only eligible non-shared sandbox workspaces after successful runtime cleanup and proves shared, agent, browser, backend, and `rw` safety.

options.title: Pause Until Fork Is Superseded
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR first so there is one canonical implementation route before more repair work starts.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Work
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 explicitly cover idle/max-age workspace cleanup, refresh exact-head proof, and close this issue after that path merges.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest sandbox lifecycle history and owns the broader managed lifecycle work that may absorb this fix.
